description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order No.77 Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. Order under Section 20(5) Maximum Retail Price for Rice
reasoning: This gazette contains an order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes regulatory requirements (maximum retail prices for rice varieties and packaging restrictions) for importers, suppliers, producers, distributors, and traders. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters.
